The characters on the round keys are slightly soft and lack the crisp embossing or printing edges expected on a real typewriter. They look somewhat 'painted on' rather than physically indented.

The mechanical arms and typebars at the top of the image are fused and indistinct. They lack the clear, separate geometric structures of real typewriter mechanisms, appearing as a melted mass of metal.
